comments.content: The `extension_description_overrides` vector is now only populated for filters that do not contain a `*` wildcard. Since `FileTypeInfo` expects `extension_description_overrides` to be parallel to `extensions`, this misaligns the descriptions with the extension groups whenever a wildcard filter appears before a normal filter. For example, with filters `[['*'], ['Images', ['png']]]`, `extensions` will contain only the `png` group but `extension_description_overrides` will be empty, so the description for the `png` filter will be lost. The override should be pushed for every filter (or at least kept in sync with `extensions`).
